1.caption: Tracking shot down a crowded Last City market street, a Guardian walking away from camera through civilians. Warm, lived-in. Burned-in 'Not Actual Gameplay' disclaimer.

2.caption: Close-up of a young city child being led by the hand through the market. Burned-in disclaimer text.

3.caption: An Eliksni busker plays a stringed instrument in the market crowd — the alliance made ordinary. Burned-in disclaimer.

4.caption: Push-in on the child holding a piece of fruit, lit warm against the stalls. Burned-in disclaimer.

5.caption: High crane over market stalls and awnings, produce crates and banners. Burned-in disclaimer.

7.caption: Two distant lights burn through heavy red fog — something enormous implied but never shown.

8.caption: A Ghost lies still on a floor in raking amber light, shell open and dim. Quiet aftermath insert.

10.caption: Mara Sov in fur mantle and gold sigil, hand raised mid-sentence, teal rim light. Commanding, wary.

11.caption: A tall pale figure stands in a dark hall, backlit red — the antagonist glimpsed, not examined.

12.caption: Extreme close-up on a white Exo faceplate, dark eyes catching red light. Still and resolute.

13.caption: Low shot of armored Titan boots planted on grey lunar rock, mountains beyond. Anonymous, monumental.

14.caption: Zavala kneels on a windswept ridge, shield on his back, staring off. Weary command.

15.caption: A single silhouetted Guardian dwarfed by the vast pale sphere of the Traveler in cloud.

16.caption: The curve of a world seen from orbit, its surface veined with fire.

17.caption: Over-the-shoulder on two helmeted Guardians in a dim briefing space, teal light.

18.caption: Ikora Rey braces a hand against a comrade, lit teal and gold, urgent mid-conversation.

19.caption: A helmeted Guardian sits amid crew in a dim hold, framed between two foreground figures.

20.caption: A ring of Guardians resting on crates and rock in low red light — the quiet before.

21.caption: A Hunter in a hooded helm with a green visor stands still against teal haze. Fully anonymous, fully iconic.

22.caption: Zavala lit cold blue in a cockpit, jaw set, looking out past camera.

23.caption: A lone Guardian silhouetted at the center of an enormous violet detonation, debris hanging in the shockwave.

24.caption: A cloaked Guardian looks down over the lit city at dusk, a vast dark hull hanging above it.

25.caption: A Guardian stands on a ridge in pale cloud, facing a distant black pyramid. Small figure, huge sky.

26.caption: Jagged red rock spires under a bruised sky, a rift glowing violet in the distance.

27.caption: Two Guardians advance shoulder to shoulder with rifles raised, drenched in red light.

28.caption: A blast door parts on a bright impossible garden — white architecture, green growth, a pyramid of light.

29.caption: A Ghost hovers alone in blue fog, its light the only warm thing in frame.

30.caption: Wreckage half-buried in blowing sand, a broken hull ring in the foreground.

31.caption: A scorched red helmet lies abandoned against dark stonework.

32.caption: Discarded rifles lie scattered in wet grass — a field after the fighting.

33.caption: A solar detonation blooms straight into camera, orange filaments tearing outward.

34.caption: Cayde-6 under a hood, blue Exo faceplate and burning eyes emerging from shadow. The return shot.

35.caption: Profile of a helmeted Titan against pale sky, visor catching the light.

36.caption: A lone cloaked figure walks out across an enormous grey-green plain under storm cloud. Pure scale.

37.caption: Guardians move up through red-lit ruins in loose formation, dust in the air.

38.caption: Zavala framed against a burning orange horizon, shield over his shoulder, eyes forward.

39.caption: Insert on an armored gauntlet reaching out through gloom.

40.caption: Two hands reach toward each other across a dark room — one gloved and red, one bare.

41.caption: The gauntleted hand closes the last of the distance, fingers spread.

42.caption: A helmeted Guardian stands over a shrouded body laid out on pale cloth. Blue, still, funerary.

43.caption: Zavala stands full-height against grey cloud, shield rigged on his back.

44.caption: A winged silhouette stands centered in a vast ring of white light. Held at distance; face never given.

45.caption: Tight profile of Zavala in blue light, the ghost of a smile breaking through.

46.caption: A single red-armored Guardian walks alone through violet fog, tiny against the dark.

47.caption: A helmeted Guardian pushes into blinding white light, lens flares streaking across frame.

48.caption: Fire pours down a monolithic dark structure, embers filling the lower frame.

49.caption: A shape moves in the red dark, barely resolved. Deliberately unreadable.

50.caption: A Guardian swings a blade mid-charge as allies close in, violet and fire light colliding.

51.caption: A dark limb lashes across frame in red gloom.

52.caption: An antagonist's face turns into the light, eyes burning amber. Held only a beat.

53.caption: A blazing white gate opens in a red hall, a shape rising in front of it.

54.caption: A vast scorched valley under a churning violet storm.

55.caption: Guardians charge through smoke, motion-blurred, weapons up.

56.caption: Overhead wide: a Guardian at the center of an arc detonation, blue lightning branching across the ground.

57.caption: Mara Sov levels a hand cannon into the dark, pale hair and scaled mantle catching low light.

58.caption: Red spires under a burning sky, a raised hand entering frame at the edge.

59.caption: A single red eye glows through a wall of flame.

60.caption: A Guardian drives a blade forward through a wall of fire, face lit gold by the blast.

62.caption: A hooded Hunter raises a crackling arc weapon overhead against a night sky. Anonymous and heroic.

63.caption: A fleet of ships streams into a bright rift over a shattered landscape.

64.caption: A Guardian hurls a torrent of blue-white energy across a dark field, hands trailing light.

65.caption: A hooded Guardian turns through drifting embers, orange firelight raking the helmet.
